committee_action.meethigh:
Suggestions:
â€¢	To provide a provision on when the tests would be administered and at what level in high school should it be administered. 
â€¢	To provide a provision for a more personal, one-to-one counseling to high school students for their career choice.
â€¢	Leniency with the requirements of the Guidance Counselor profession in order to entice students to pursue a Guidance Counseling career.
â€¢	Rewording of Section 10 to be clear that the system will not be mandatory but shall serve as guidance to students in choosing a career path.
â€¢	Impose a punitive provision on ranking and advertisement of schools as mentioned in Section 14.
â€¢	Make private educational institutions part of the system.
â€¢	For DepEd to study the German Dual Education System which may be replicable and appropriate to the Philippine educational setting considering the commencement of Enhanced K to 12 Basic Education System.
â€¢	For DepEd to comment on the cut-off score as provided in Section 10.

Agreements reached:

â€¢	Technical Working Group was created to fine-tune the provisions of the bill.
â€¢	Committee shall await the endorsement of the DepEd prior to its final action on HB 1753.
